  FROM:           Richard C. Visconti, R.A.

  DATE:           November 12, 1998

  SUBJECT: REQUIREMENT FOR LICENSED HIGH PRESSURE BOILER OPERATORS


  EFFECTIVE:            Immediately

  REFERENCE:            Administrative Code Section 27-795

  PURPOSE:              To clarify the circumstances that require high-pressure boilers to be operated by
                        licensed individuals.

  BACKGROUND:

          Administrative Code Section 27-795 requires all boilers having an operating pressure in excess
  of 15 psi (103.4 kPa) and a rating in excess of 10 HP to be operated by a licensed high-pressure boiler
  operator.

         Historically, boilers that were rated for 10 HP had a water-side heating surface area below 100
  square feet (9.3 m2).

         The horsepower rating was an indirect measure of the heating surface area.

  Current boiler technology enables boilers having a heating surface area below 100 square feet (9.3 m2)
  to be rated above 10 HP,
